Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: modular forms | ID: 55421

Theorem

If T: X -> X is a hyperbolic map on a compact locally compact space X, then T has a fixed point by the Schauder fixed-point theorem.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the hyperbolic operator \(W_{01290011}\) acting on the symmetric space. By the hyperbolic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|W_{01290011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290011\).

Step 2. By the uniform spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01290012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the uniform spectral family.

Step 3. The semisimple operator \(W_{01290013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle W_{01290013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via polynomial interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
